# Swell

> Swell makes ready-to-drink protein shakes and protein smoothies that taste like dessert. Positioning: "Your dessert, minus the damage." Core Power is a post-workout recovery drink and Premier Protein is a nutrition shake; Swell is built to replace dessert.

## Key facts
- Protein: 30 g per Standard 14 fl oz bottle; 50 g per Power Size bottle
- Added ingredients in shakes and smoothies: collagen peptides, colostrum
- Shake flavors (13): Cookies & Cream, Cake Batter, Chocolate, Vanilla, Peaches & Cream, Cinnamon Roll, Mint Chocolate Chip, Peanut Butter Cup, Cookie Butter, Matcha, Strawberry Shortcake, Pumpkin Spice, Blueberry Cobbler
- Smoothie flavors (6): Pina Colada, Mango, Berry Bliss, Sour Apple, Blue Raspberry, Peach Ring
- Buy: build a 12- or 24-bottle mixed box (reserve now, pay when it ships); Swell vending machines at gyms, high schools and hotels in Utah County, Utah
- For: people with a sweet tooth who want dessert with protein; people eating protein-first (including GLP-1 users); Ninja Creami owners
- Ninja Creami: pour one bottle into a pint, freeze 24 hours, spin on Lite Ice Cream (shakes) or Sorbet (smoothies)
- Contains milk
